fields.description: This will be appended to the Item Code of the variant. For example, if your abbreviation is "SM", and the item code is "T-SHIRT", the item code of the variant will be "T-SHIRT-SM"
fields.label: Abbreviation

fields.description: Short display name used in technical code patterns (Specification Number Template). Falls back to abbreviation if empty.
fields.label: Short Name

fields.description: Human-readable label used in variant name patterns (e.g. 'прот', 'терм'). Falls back to short_name, then abbreviation.
fields.label: Display Name

fields.description: Optional. When this attribute value is used in a variant, the linked item will replace the template item in the BOM.
fields.label: Linked Item
